test_title: PYST 46: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven girls A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). D is second to the right of G. G is third to the right of C. F is third to the right of B. A is not the immediate neighbour of C. E is the immediate neighbour of C. Who is second to the right of A?
solution:
Seven girls A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1) D is second to the right of G and G is third to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0c9e4434f701602f12e8d6d8c2b96663e763a860b56fc6e3e99cb3e9d496290.png] 

2) F is third to the right of B and A is not the immediate neighbour of C and E is the immediate neighbour of C.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60a16acd30e8e885c5043fe0ac501da1ea5bf57774371fb8a9f6012643db1ea3.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16c3c79bbf05d15a5914f2ac6860e256310c02215565ac878e6931b74042c90f.png] 

From Case (i) and case (ii) second to right of 'A' has to be either B or F. In given option there is no 'F'

∴ By considering Case(ii) 'B' is second to right of 'A'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B".**
